==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|acqueren}}, from {{der|en|fro|aquerre}}, from {{der|en|la|acquirō}}; {{m|la|ad-}} + {{m|la|quaerō|t=to seek for}}. See {{m|en|quest}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈkwaɪɚ/|a=GA}}
* {{IPA|en|/əˈkwaɪə/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-acquire.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪə(ɹ)|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|ac|quire}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[get]].
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[gain]], usually by one's own [[exertion]]s; to get as one's own.
#: {{co|en|to '''acquire''' a skill}}
#: {{co|en|to '''acquire''' decent habits and manners}}
#: {{ux|en|He '''acquired''' a title.}}
#: {{ux|en|All the riches he '''acquired''' were from hard work.}}
#: {{ux|en|One should '''acquire''' as much knowledge as possible from reading.}}
#* {{RQ:Barrow Works|sermonname=The Consideration of our Latter End|passage=No virtue is '''acquired''' in an instant, but by degrees, step by step.}}
#* {{RQ:Blackstone Commentaries
|passage=Descent is the title whereby a man, on the death of his ancestor, '''acquires''' his estate, by right of representation, as his heir at law.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2012|author=w:Nadine Gordimer|title=No Time Like the Present|page=46|publisher=Bloomsbury|year_published=2013
|passage=If you're black you've had to improvise communication with unilingual whites, she'd probably easily '''acquire''' this ancient one, too.}}
# {{lb|en|medicine}} To become affected by an illness.
#: {{syn|en|contract|catch|get}}
# {{lb|en|computing}} To sample signals and convert them into digital values.
# {{lb|en|North America|military}} To begin tracking a mobile target with a particular detector or sight, generally with the implication that an attack on the target thereby becomes possible.

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|stem=acquir|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|get, gain}} {{l|en|attain}}, {{l|en|come by}}, {{l|en|earn}}, {{l|en|gain}}, {{l|en|obtain}}, {{l|en|procure}}, {{l|en|secure}}, {{l|en|win}}

====Antonyms====
* {{antsense|get, gain}} {{l|en|abandon}}, {{l|en|lose}}
